name: Sound Space Plus
description:
Sound Space Plus is an open-source, rhythm-based aim precision game. Challenging players to hit targets to the beat of diverse music tracks, it tests both auditory rhythm and mouse cursor aim speed.

Features:
- Precision aim mechanics combining rhythm timing with 2D spatial targeting
- Access to an extensive library of community-created beatmaps and songs
- Customizable visual elements, cursor skins, particle effects, and note styles
- Detailed performance analysis and timing accuracy breakdowns
- Multiple game modifiers to customize challenge and gameplay speed
